title: Positive-degree vanishing for graded exterior multiplication
statement:
theorem koszulJoinGraded_bijective_of_pos
    {A : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] (r : ℕ) (a : Fin (r + 1) → A)
    (m : ℕ) (i : ℤ) (hi : 0 < i) :
    Function.Bijective (koszulJoinGraded r a m i).hom

source.place: Tag 0664, lemma-join-sequences-koszul-complex, proof hint: exterior generators of the two factors and their Koszul differentials.

proof.text: For i>0, extension by ComplexShape.embeddingDownNat makes every target Koszul term zero. For each tensor summand p+q=i, either p>0 or q>0; the corresponding factor is zero, so the tensor summand is zero. The coproduct of these zero summands is zero, and any morphism between zero objects is an isomorphism, hence bijective.

proof_origin.place: Tag 0664, ordered subset basis decomposition of the head-tail exterior product.
